title: Slay the Demon
summary: On the Ancient Battlefield of Sky Demon Country, the Scattered Devil sends its Demon Servants Feng Yin, De Gui and Hu Pao to kill Wang Lin, but his Annihilation Finger and an Immortal Realm hand seal turn back the first attackers. Hu Pao, Wang Lin's former disciple, now hates him for not saving him from prison, and plans to kill everyone who knows the Soul Refining Technique so that only he holds it. Using the Time Spell from his benefactor, Hu Pao jumps from late Soul Transformation to early Ascendant with his Hundred Million Soul Flag, but Wang Lin, as the true heir of the technique, calls the souls back, and the spell drains Hu Pao's life until he falls back to mid Soul Transformation. Ming Yuan, a late Ascendant, then fights Wang Lin with demonic energy, while Wang Lin uses the Yellow Springs, the Soul Gathering Spring and the Slaughter Immortal Art and finally Ling Tianhou's sword qi to strike the Demon Tower itself. The Scattered Devil comes out in a flesh body far above Ascendant, and Wang Lin's clone blows itself up to destroy the Demon Tower and a million years of the devil's savings.
events: Feng Yin, De Gui and Hu Pao are sent to kill Wang Lin
Wang Lin repels the first servants with Annihilation Finger and an Immortal Realm hand seal
Xu Liguo appears; Hu Pao confronts Wang Lin and declares his hatred
Hu Pao reaches early Ascendant with the Time Spell and his Hundred Million Soul Flag
Wang Lin takes back the souls; the spell drains Hu Pao to mid Soul Transformation
Ming Yuan fights Wang Lin; Wang Lin aims Ling Tianhou's sword qi at the Demon Tower
The Scattered Devil appears and Wang Lin's clone self-destructs, wrecking the tower
cultivation: Hu Pao: late Soul Transformation, forced to early Ascendant by the Time Spell, then falls back to late and mid Soul Transformation. Ming Yuan: late Ascendant. The Scattered Devil's flesh body is above Ascendant.
